name: RapVideoGo
tagline: Make a short rap video from photos and your own lyrics
description: RapVideoGo is a browser-based generator for short, personalized rap videos. Start with one or two photos of consenting adults, choose a scene such as a birthday duet or studio performance, and edit the lyrics or start from a template. Select a video format before generation, then download the finished clip with AI-generated vocals and a beat. It is designed for people making short celebrations and music-themed clips without a timeline editor. Generation uses paid credits; one-time packs start at $6.99 for 10 credits.
